# Synplant Scripts SDK

> Docs, agent notes and schemas for writing Synplant 2.0.2 scripts (JavaScript, Cushy GUI, IVG graphics, Mods). Read core-card.md first, then open only the line ranges you need. Paths are relative to the SDK root, which in a project is usually references/synplant-scripts-sdk/.

Generated by tools/generate-doc-index.js; do not edit. Each line is: line range, size in tokens (chars/4), section. Read only the lines you need, for example with `sed -n 120,180p <file>`.

- Core card, agents/synplant-script-writer/core-card.md: rules for every task, 1.4k. Always load it.
